title: Waveform trim
description: Fine audio samples and quiet regions make direct range trimming precise and legible.
useCase: Select a precise excerpt without losing the surrounding recording.
interaction: Drag trim handles or the selection; use arrows, Shift+arrows, Home or End
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Synthetic amplitude data. Range changes are local; no audio decoding, destructive trim or export.
look: Light grey page with a white rounded card holding a fine vertical-bar waveform, a monospace time ruler, dark trim handles and monospace in/out readouts.
motion: Dragging a dark handle or the selected region moves the trim range 1:1 with the pointer, darkening bars inside and greying those outside; arrow keys nudge 1% or 5%.
adapt: Range state is `range` (percent), updated by `down`, `move`, `change` and `key` with a 5% minimum gap; `BARS` is synthetic amplitude data and 0.42 converts percent to seconds. Replace `BARS` with decoded peaks and wire `range` to playback or export.
